annotations.title: Buy Fermi credits with your saved card

description:
Buys Fermi credits by charging the card saved on your account, and returns the new balance. Use this when the user explicitly asks to buy or top up Fermi credits.

Returns credits_purchased, new_balance and payment_status. If no card is saved yet, nothing is charged: it returns a checkout_url for the user to save a card in a browser, then call this again.

Credits pay for estimates on an account (see estimate_quantity_or_probability for tier costs). To see the balance first, use check_account_and_credits. To get an account, call POST https://fermi.kromatic.com/api/v1/accounts (it returns an api_key once; a new account starts with 3 credits), or sign in through your connector. If you cannot make HTTP requests, ask the user to do one of these.

Cost: real money -- charges the saved card $0.50 per credit. Needs an account.

api_key.description: Your Fermi API key. Omit it if your connector is signed in with permission to buy credits.
api_key.title: Api Key

credits.description: How many credits to buy, at least 1. Each is charged at the price in this tool's cost line.
credits.title: Credits

name: buy_credits

outputSchema.description: Either a completed purchase (credits_purchased, new_balance, payment_status) or, with no saved card, a checkout_url and credits_added 0.

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

checkout_url.description: No card saved: open this in a browser to save one, then call buy_credits again.

credits_added.description: 0 when a checkout_url is returned instead.

outputSchema.title: BuyCreditsResult

title: Buy Fermi credits with your saved card
